segments.name: Online Personal Styling
segments.description: Sells apparel, shoes and accessories to clients in the United States through curated Fix shipments chosen by Stylists and Freestyle direct purchases.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment and, as a result, one reportable segment related to the sale of merchandise directly to clients who received a curated shipment of items or purchased directly from its website or mobile app.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay a styling fee for each Fix, credited toward any merchandise purchased, and also buy items directly through Freestyle.
revenueModel.evidence: We charge clients a styling fee of $20 for each Fix, which is credited toward any merchandise purchased.

changes.text: In fiscal 2024 the company ceased operations of its U.K. business and reported it as a discontinued operation.
changes.evidence: In fiscal 2024, we ceased operations of our U.K. business and met the accounting requirements for reporting the UK business as a discontinued operation.
